question: Which of the following describes a prominent visual feature indicating damage or missing content within the main body of the inscription?
options: A series of distinct vertical cracks extends from top to bottom.
A large, irregular white patch is visible in the lower-left quadrant.
The entire central section of the inscription is completely blank.
Numerous small, uniformly circular holes are scattered across the surface.
correct_semantic_answer: A large, irregular white patch is visible in the lower-left quadrant.
visual_evidence: A distinct, irregularly shaped white area, indicative of a lacuna or damage, is clearly visible within the inscribed text, positioned towards the bottom-left portion of the main inscription block.
